requirements.requirement: Fan out clk and reset_n to all submodules.
Aggregate all safety and status indications into status_telemetry and fault_code.
Expose one-cycle registered actuator output selection with safe fallback behavior.
Prevent issuance of model requests when any safety criterion fails.
Ensure all top-level outputs are driven by registered logic only.
Every externally visible state update is synchronous to clk.
All request issuance is blocked unless geometry_valid, flow_valid, and safe_mode allow release.
actuator_command is selected through a registered mux with one full cycle of stability before release.
status_telemetry encodes geometry_accept, flow_valid, request_outstanding, response_fresh, safe_mode, envelope_fault, stale_response, command_clamped, and fallback_active.

Synchronize and sample geometry input metadata.
Detect unsupported geometry format and malformed metadata.
Produce a stable accepted geometry descriptor for downstream blocks.
Provide geometry_valid only for accepted inputs and geometry_reject for rejection cases.
geometry_valid may assert only on a cycle where vehicle_geometry_valid is asserted and format/metadata checks pass.
geometry_reject asserts when format is not STL-compatible or metadata is malformed.
Geometry descriptor changes only when a valid input is accepted.
No combinational propagation of raw geometry inputs to any later stage is permitted without registered capture.

On reset_n deassertion, geometry_valid clears low, geometry_reject clears low, and geometry_descriptor resets to a known safe zero state.
Synchronize and sample flow condition metadata.
Compare stream_velocity_mps against fixed programmable bounds representing 20 m/s and 55 m/s.
Indicate nominal_condition for the supplied reference point of 38.89 m/s.
Provide a registered flow_descriptor for downstream transaction use.
flow_valid may assert only when stream_velocity_mps is within the approved operating envelope.
Values outside the envelope must assert envelope_fault and force flow_valid low.
nominal_condition is informational only and does not override flow_valid or envelope_fault.
All comparisons are synchronous and fixed-width; no floating-point or non-synthesizable logic is used.

On reset_n deassertion, flow_valid clears low, envelope_fault clears low, nominal_condition clears low, and flow_descriptor resets to a known safe zero state.
Maintain a monotonic request_id counter.
Capture and hold request timestamp for freshness comparisons.
Generate req_valid, req_id, and req_payload for the external service.
Track outstanding request state and expose request_outstanding.
Detect response mismatch and freshness status.
Provide validated response payload only after matching and fresh response acceptance.
A request may issue only when geometry_valid, flow_valid, safe_mode low, fallback_active low, and req_ready high.
req_id must increase monotonically on each accepted request.
Freshness requires resp_id equal to outstanding_req_id and resp_timestamp greater than or equal to outstanding_req_timestamp.
Stale or mismatched responses must be discarded and must not update validated_resp_payload.
A single internal free-running counter or equivalent synchronous timebase shall supply request_timestamp values.

Validate response structure and freshness conditions.
Provide explicit model output fields as opaque control inputs.
Suppress invalid or stale responses from reaching the policy stage.
Expose stale_response for safety supervision and telemetry.
model_output_valid may assert only when resp_valid is high, the transaction matches, and freshness checks pass.
No numerical prediction or range inference is embedded in the RTL.

notes: This is a conformance analysis, not a formal proof.
Missing or partial items should be reviewed and turned into executable assertions/tests where needed.
Inconclusive is preserved when the checker lacks enough evidence; no fake pass is reported.
